name: Piecewise Constant Approximation Inverse
aliases: Inverse CDF with Piecewise Constant Density
definition: An explicit formula to solve for time $t$ given a target integral value $y$, assuming density $ho_r$ is constant within each sample interval $[t_{j-1}, t_j]$.
summary: Piecewise Constant Approximation Inverse computes sample positions by assuming density is constant within intervals, yielding a linear equation that is simpler but less accurate than piecewise linear methods.
